tabs.commandsHint: Command palette (⌘K or Ctrl+K); “?” lists the shortcuts

setup.shareTab: In the video call, share the tab “Shared screen” rather than your whole screen.
setup.keys: Drive from this tab: <kbd>→</kbd> next, <kbd>←</kbd> previous, <kbd>Space</kbd> timer.

started: Here we go! The intro starts on the shared screen.
endedReview: The meeting is over. Review the minutes in the right-hand pane, then archive them.
pendingRequests: {count, plural, one {# raised hand or question pending} other {# raised hands or questions pending}}

icebreaker.none: No icebreaker: add questions in the settings.
icebreaker.answersErased: Answers already given will be erased.

spotlight.title: Spotlight on the shared screen
spotlight.inCheckIn: On screen: highlighted in the check-in
spotlight.inBanner: On screen: as a banner, at the bottom of the stage
spotlight.messagePlaceholder: Or a free message, shown as a banner

sounds.participantsHint: They are turned on on everyone's “My screen”, and each person can turn them off or set their volume. Do not share audio in the video call.
sounds.screenHint: Click the shared screen once to allow sound, and share the tab audio in the video call.
sounds.musicHint: Before the start only, looping: it fades out when the meeting starts.

notes.title: What the minutes will keep · {label}
notes.pinned: You are finishing the notes of {pinned}; the screen moved on to {label}.
notes.placeholder:
What the team should remember from this turn. For example:
{decision}: we move to the new deployment pipeline
Acceptance tests slip to the 15th, to be confirmed with the client
notes.decisionHint: Adds a decision: it will also be listed at the top of the minutes
notes.actionHint: Creates a follow-up action with an owner: it will be tracked in the following weeks

run.shuffled: Order shuffled for those who have not spoken yet
run.checkInStale: Check-in from before their absence, not updated
run.legend: Green dot: check-in filled in. <note></note>: notes taken for the minutes. “Check-in” lets you fix it if needed. A “Questions” step is added by itself as soon as a hand is raised.

unsavedCheckIn: The check-in changes are not saved.
pastDate: Past date: pick the date of this meeting.

topics.added: Topic added to the open topics

stop.endAsk: Jump straight to the wrap-up? The remaining steps are skipped.
stop.resetAsk: Go back to the waiting screen? The timer, raised hands, questions, reactions and kudos of this session are erased. Check-ins and your notes are kept.
stop.ended: Meeting ended: review the minutes, then archive them.
stop.reset: Start cancelled: back to the waiting screen.

check.title: Before archiving
check.decisions: {count, plural, =0 {No decision noted} one {# decision noted} other {# decisions noted}}
check.actions: {count, plural, =0 {No follow-up action created} one {# follow-up action created} other {# follow-up actions created}}
check.hint: Nothing to remember for someone? That happens. Otherwise, click their name to complete the {notes}.

minutesPane.generationFailed: The minutes could not be generated.
minutesPane.intro: Generated from your notes, the check-ins, the questions and the actions: complete your notes to change them, and pick the team inputs to keep.
minutesPane.notesOnly: your notes and the actions only
minutesPane.alwaysIncluded: Your notes and the follow-up actions are always included. This choice is kept for the next meetings.
minutesPane.archiveAtEnd: Archiving happens at the wrap-up of the meeting.
minutesPane.archiveAsk: Archive and empty the check-ins of those present?
minutesPane.archived: Meeting archived with its minutes. The next one is ready.
minutesPane.summaryHint: Optional: a few lines shown at the top of the minutes. They can still be edited from the history.
minutesPane.summaryPlaceholder: In a few lines: what to remember from this meeting (optional)

remote.title: Phone remote
remote.hint: Scan this code with your phone, signed in with your account: big buttons to move on, pause and give extra time, while the shared screen follows.
remote.scan: QR code of the phone remote

parking.title: Parking lot
parking.hint: Set aside what comes up off-topic: it shows on the screen, goes into the minutes and becomes an open topic of the next session.

async.title: Meeting without a live session
async.hint: Everyone fills in their check-in and comments on the others' until {when}. The session is then archived by itself and the digest goes out by email.
async.hintNoTime: Everyone fills in their check-in and comments on the others'. Publish the digest when the team is ready.
async.confirm: Archive this session and email the digest to the team now?
async.orLive: You can still start a live meeting instead.

startToday: This session was planned for another day: starting now dates it today, and the planned date stays in the schedule.
projectNoSpeaker: Nobody working on it is here: its sheet speaks for it.
projectsSkippedTitle: {count, plural, one {Nothing written about this project: it is not presented.} other {Nothing written about these projects: they are not presented.}}
projectUnadd: Take {name} out of this session's round

sheets.title: Project sheets
sheets.todo: {count, plural, one {# to complete} other {# to complete}}
sheets.headline: message of the day
sheets.showAll: Show the complete ones too ({count} in all)
sheets.noMatch: No project of that name to complete.
sheets.allDoneHint: Every sheet is complete: health, message of the day and a line from each of their people.
